biggest_catch: The friend must complete 12 debit card transactions AND set up direct deposit/autopay within 60 days of opening - that's a demanding qualification bar.
catches: Referrer earns a $50 Visa Reward Card for each individual referred who registers, opens a new FKCB personal checking account, and completes the requirements.
Referrer must register for the program and share the offer.

Friend requirements: register for the offer, open a new personal checking account, and within 60 days complete 12 debit card transactions, set up direct deposit or automatic payments, and enroll in online banking with eStatements.
Limit 10 Visa Reward Cards ($500) per calendar year.
Only one referrer may receive a reward for each referred person who fulfills the requirements.
Card delivery takes 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed; rewards may be reported as income to the IRS.
Program may be discontinued or changed at any time.
